`create_model` computes `flat_snapshots` and converts the snapshots stored in `n.model.parameters`, but never converts `sns` itself. Thus, for multi-period networks with `"flat"` (or `"auto"` under v1 semantics), the variable and constraint builders still receive the original MultiIndex, regardless of `transmission_losses`; the component-data context does not change those arguments.
